contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: YesStyle promotional [coupons](/en/coupons/yesstyle) go in the Coupon Code field and have their own rules: validity, minimum purchase, region and eligible products. CECILIA010 is a reward code: it goes in the Reward Code field and gives 5% extra on a first purchase and 2% on later ones. Check both discounts in the order summary before you pay.

contentSections.heading: Why is a YesStyle coupon rejected at checkout?
paragraphs: If you have copied a YesStyle coupon code and watched the checkout reject it, the reason is almost always in the promotion's rules.

The most common ones: the coupon expired (many campaigns last 72 to 96 hours, others a month), the campaign is valid only in some regions, the order did not reach the minimum, the product is not part of the promotion, or the account is not eligible. [YesStyle's general coupon rules](https://www.yesstyle.com/en/general-terms-and-conditions-for-coupons/help/section.html/hsi.1888) explain these conditions.
To avoid wasting time at payment, understand the two discount fields and check the conditions of each promotion.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions about YesStyle coupons
paragraphs: Here are readers' main questions about using coupons and reward codes at YesStyle:
bullets: What is the difference between a Coupon Code and an Influencer/Rewards Code at YesStyle? The Coupon Code is the promotion coupon, entered in the “Coupon Code” field, with its own deadline and rules: it may have a minimum purchase, a regional restriction or ineligible products. CECILIA010 is the reward code (Influencer/Rewards Code), entered in the separate “Reward Code” field, with 5% on a first purchase and 2% on the following ones. When the promotion's rules allow it, both discounts can show up together in the order summary.
What is YesStyle's influencer code? It is the Reward Code, typed into its own checkout field, separate from the coupon field. Ours is CECILIA010, which goes in the Reward Code field.

Do YesStyle coupons expire? Yes. Promotional coupons have an expiry date and can end without notice. Some campaigns last only a few days (such as 72- or 96-hour promotions), while others stay active for different periods. Before you finish the purchase, check the validity, the minimum amount, the region and the eligible products in the promotion's rules, and confirm the discount showed up at checkout.

Where do I find the official rules for YesStyle coupons? The general rules are on the “General Terms and Conditions for Coupons” page of YesStyle's help center. For the terms of a specific campaign, go to the Help Center and open the “Promotions” section, where YesStyle publishes the validity, minimum purchase, participating regions and possible exclusions. Because these terms change, also check the promotion banner and the order summary before you pay.

Can I use more than one promotional coupon on the same order? No. Under YesStyle's general rules, only one Coupon Code can be used per order or combined order. CECILIA010, however, is not a Coupon Code: it must be applied in the separate “Reward Code” field. That is why a promotional coupon and CECILIA010 can be combined when the campaign is eligible and the checkout accepts both.
